title: Employee Spotlight: Megan, Account Executive
summary: Learn what its like to work at Instawork from our very own team members, including one of our Account Executive, Megan.
body_markdown:
Our mission at Instawork is to create economic opportunities for local businesses and professionals, globally. In order to achieve that mission, we have built a team composed of talented and hard-working individuals who are passionate about connecting skilled hourly professionals with local businesses who need their services.


Our *Employee Spotlight* series takes the opportunity to highlight members of our team and to give a glimpse into our culture and what it’s like to work at Instawork. To highlight the diversity of our team, we’ve asked ***Megan, Account Executive,*** to share more about her experience working at Instawork.


‍


### **What do you do at Instawork and how long have you been with the company?**


Recently promoted to AE, previously an Senior SDR. Been with instawork since mid-May 2024, so almost a year and a half.


‍


‍


### **What initially attracted you to Instawork?**


I wanted to work for a company that I could believe in and one that supported their brand and aimed to do good. I actually learned more about the company after reaching out to the previous General Counsel and thought the company was super interesting.


‍


‍


### **What's your favorite part of your job?**


Getting the opportunity to work with and learn from so many talented, smart, and inspiring people.


‍


### **What is one piece of “work from home” equipment you couldn’t live without?**


My dog.


‍


### **What's the most important thing you've learned since starting at Instawork?**


The importance of collaboration with my peers and leaders.


‍


### **In 10 words or less, how would you describe the culture at Instawork?**


Fast-moving yet supportive, and driven by shared success.


‍


Visit our[Careers page](https://jobs.lever.co/instawork) to see current job opportunities at Instawork.


‍
